Add comprehensive Topping model with pricing logic Implemented ToppingType enum to support MEAT, CHEESE, REGULAR, SAUCE, and SIDE categories.Added constructors for standard and extra toppings, including support for marking toppings as extra.Created dynamic pricing logic based on sandwich size and topping type using switch expressions. Implemented separate pricing rules for regular and extra meat/cheese toppings.Added getter and setter methods for topping properties to support encapsulation.Overrode toString() method to display toppings clearly, including extra topping labels.

Enhance Chips model with order summary support Added fixed-price Chips class to represent side items in customer orders. Create Drink class with pricing and summary functionality Added Size enum to support SMALL, MEDIUM, and LARGE drink options. Implemented dynamic pricing logic based on selected drink size. Added formatted summary output for receipts and order details. Included getter methods for drink size and flavor properties.

Build customizable Sandwich model with toppings and pricing system Implemented sandwich customization with bread type, size, toasted option, and categorized toppings. Added support for meats, cheeses, regular toppings, sauces, and sides using ArrayLists. Created dynamic pricing logic based on sandwich size and premium toppings.Implemented formatted order summary generation for receipts and customer orders. Added validation for sandwich sizes and getter methods for encapsulation.

Create Order class to manage customer purchases Added ArrayLists to store sandwiches, drinks, and chips within an order. Implemented Order constructor to initialize all order item collections. Prepared foundation for handling customer order totals and receipt generation.

Implemented getTotal() method to calculate the complete order price from sandwiches, drinks, and chips. Added order validation to ensure customers cannot place empty orders. Supported flexible ordering by allowing orders with sandwiches, drinks, or chips combinations.

Added getOrderSummary() method to display a complete customer receipt. Included detailed sections for sandwiches, drinks, and chips with item summaries.Implemented dynamic total calculation display and empty-order handling for sandwiches. Improved order readability with formatted headers, separators, and item numbering.

Add getter methods for order item collections Implemented getters for sandwiches, drinks, and chips lists. Improved encapsulation and external access to order data. Prepared Order class for receipt generation and order management features.

Implement receipt file generation and order saving Added logic to create uniquely named receipt files using timestamps. Implemented receipt writing with order summary, date/time, and thank-you message.Used BufferedWriter with try-with-resources for safe file handling.Added exception handling for receipt saving errors and success confirmation messages.

Add timestamp formatting for unique receipt filenames Implemented DateTimeFormatter with custom yyyyMMdd-HHmmss pattern. Generated formatted timestamps using LocalDateTime for receipt file naming. Ensured unique and organized receipt filenames based on date and time.
